sections.name: Police: LSPD, sheriff and Highway Patrol

lines.line: Summary: The Los Santos Police Department (LSPD) covers the city of Los Santos, its airport and its port, the Los Santos County Sheriff's Department (LSSD) covers Blaine County as well, and the San Andreas Highway Patrol (SAHP) patrols the highways on Police Bikes.

quoted: The LSPD has jurisdiction over the entirety of Los Santos, as well as Del Perro, Davis, and Rockford Hills, despite those being different cities.
They also have jurisdiction over Los Santos International Airport and the Port of Los Santos
that operates in Los Santos County, San Andreas, as well as Blaine County
SAHP has jurisdiction over the Highways of San Andreas. Officers patrol the roads using Police Bikes.

lines.line: Weak points: A gunshot to the legs kills an LSPD officer or sheriff's deputy, either at once or by blood loss. Officers are known to take cover behind or stand near a burning car that is about to explode.

quoted: any gunshot to the legs will result in them dying, either instantly or via blood loss, similarly to LSPD officers and LSSD deputies
taking cover behind or standing near a vehicle which is on fire and about to explode

lines.line: Tips: The sheriff's deputies drive and fight just like the LSPD, in Sheriff Cruisers.

quoted: The LSSD (Los Santos County Sheriff's Department) have no differences with the LSPD in driving and gunfight tactics
the LSCS in Blaine County will utilize the Sheriff Cruiser

lines.line: Tips: Highway Patrol officers shoot Pistols at you once you fire a weapon or reach two stars; those who spawned on a bike chase you on it, and those who spawned standing only chase on foot, though they may take civilian cars.

quoted: If the player shoots a weapon or has a wanted level of two or higher, SAHP officers will shoot their Pistols at the player.
any that spawned on a bike will pursue on it, however, the ones that spawned standing will only pursue on foot, though they may sometimes take NPC vehicles

sections.name: Police at one and two stars

lines.line: Summary: At one star officers, soldiers and security guards chase you, and police and soldiers try to arrest you at gunpoint. At two stars police shoot to kill, drive much more aggressively to ram you off the road, and at least three police cars chase you.

quoted: Police officers, military or security guards will begin to give chase to the player. Police officers and military personnel will attempt to arrest the player by holding them at gunpoint.
At a two-star wanted level, police become more aggressive and they will now shoot to kill.
drive much more aggressively, now attempting to ram the player off the road
At two stars, a minimum of 3 police cars will be chasing the player.

lines.line: Weak points: At one star the police only hold you at gunpoint, and fighting back or running away raises it to two stars at once. Security guards and police on motorcycles open fire straight away instead of arresting you.

quoted: The player can resist arrest at this stage by fighting back or by proceeding to flee the scene, at the cost of immediately raising their wanted level to two stars.
security guards will immediately begin to open fire on the player as they do not possess the ability to arrest them.
should the player encounter a police officer on a motorcycle, the officer will immediately begin to open fire on the player.

lines.line: Tips: At two stars police cars may wait at the roadside to ambush you, or blend into traffic with their lights and sirens off until you draw near.

quoted: police cars may now wait at the side of the road to "ambush" the player as they drive by, or blending into civilian traffic with their lights and sirens deactivated until the player draws near.

lines.line: Tips: Police only try a vehicular arrest after a chase has lasted about a minute without you hurting any cop and you stop your vehicle.

quoted: Police will not attempt a vehicular arrest unless a pursuit has lasted for approximately one minute without hurting any cop and the player stops their vehicle.

lines.line: Summary: At three stars police set up roadblocks of police cars and police transporters, sometimes with a spike strip laid out behind them, and a Police Maverick helicopter shadows you with NOOSE TRU officers riding on board.

quoted: They will set up roadblocks with their police cars and police transporters, which may also set out a spike strip on the road behind them.
A Police Maverick helicopter will be called in to shadow the player and provide air support in the form of NOOSE TRU officers that ride on board.

lines.line: Weak points: The helicopter stays on station until every rifleman on board is killed, then returns to base, but another one replaces it in short order. At night it shines a spotlight on you so the ground units can find you.

quoted: The Police helicopter will always stay on station until all riflemen on board are killed, at which point it will return to base; however, it will be replaced by another in short order.
At night, the helicopter will shine a spotlight on the player to highlight their location to ground units.

lines.line: Tips: Every officer who spawns at three stars or more wears a bulletproof vest, and officers run up to a car you have stopped in, drag you out and kill you on the spot, so keep moving.

quoted: All officers that spawn when three or more stars are attained will be wearing bulletproof vests.
Officers will run up to the player if they are stationary in a vehicle, drag them out, and instantly kill them with their weapon.

sections.name: NOOSE TRU at four and five stars

lines.line: Summary: At four stars NOOSE TRU teams come to kill you, three officers to a vehicle, in FIB Grangers in Los Santos or Sheriff SUVs in Blaine County, with two hanging off the sides firing at you while more shoot from Police Mavericks overhead. At five stars the streets fill with police and almost no civilian traffic.

quoted: At a four-star wanted level, NOOSE TRU teams will be sent to eliminate the player.
They will arrive in FIB Grangers or Sheriff SUVs, depending on whether they are in Los Santos or Blaine County.
Each vehicle contains three NOOSE TRU officers - one driving, and other two hanging on the sides as they fire their weapons at the player.
NOOSE TRU will also try to gun the player down from Police Mavericks overhead with their Carbine Rifles
The streets will now be filled with police personnel and feature almost no, if any, civilian traffic

lines.line: Weak points: They wear body armour and do not lose health quickly, but a single headshot kills them even in a helmet, and any gunshot to the legs kills them at once or by blood loss.

quoted: NOOSE TRU officers are well protected with body armour and do not lose health very quickly.
Even if they wear helmets, a single headshot will instantly kill them like all pedestrians, however.
any gunshot to the legs will result in them dying, either instantly or via blood loss

lines.line: Tips: If you hole up in a building or behind tight cover they use tear gas to force you out, and a Police Maverick may land or rappel four officers down to you.

quoted: If the player barricades themselves in a building, or behind tight cover, the officers will begin to use Tear Gas to force them out.
At four stars, some helicopters may carry four TRU officers who will rappel down to the ground; alternatively, the helicopter may land and they will get out on the ground.

lines.line: Tips: Shooting down a pursuing Police Maverick can itself raise you to four stars, though it may take two or more downed units.

quoted: Destroying a pursuing Police Maverick.
Note: It may take two or more downed units to attain the fourth star.

sections.name: Soldiers and Rhino tanks at Fort Zancudo

lines.line: Summary: The military is never called in to chase you, but near Fort Zancudo soldiers in Crusaders and Barracks join a chase and try to arrest you, and on the base itself they shoot to kill.

quoted: While the military will never be called in to pursue the player, military personnel may become involved in the chase if it occurs near Fort Zancudo.
Typically this involves soldiers in Crusaders and Barracks, who will give chase to the player and attempt to arrest them in GTA V, although they will shoot the player if they resist arrest.
On the base itself, military personnel will shoot to kill.

lines.line: Weak points: A Rhino tank takes about 3 to 4 tank shells, 5 to 6 RPG shots or 7 to 8 Grenade Launcher shots to blow up, and a hit on its rear may open the fuel tank, so that a lit fuel trail stops it after a few minutes, though its turret keeps working.

quoted: The tank can take about 3–4 tank shells, 5–6 RPG shots or 7–8 Grenade Launcher shots before exploding

attacking the back of the tank has a chance of opening the fuel tank, leaving a fuel trail behind the tank which can be ignited, immobilizing the tank after a few minutes (although the turret remains operational)

lines.line: Tips: Soldiers fire a Rocket Launcher at an aircraft if it is hijacked in the base or you are flying one of them, and patrolling Rhinos may leave the base to chase you, using their cannons, if you stay too close for too long.

quoted: If an aircraft is hijacked in base or the player is flying one of them, any soldiers will fire a Rocket Launcher at the aircraft.
Any patrolling Rhino tanks will also become involved and may exit the base to join the pursuit if the player stays too close for too long, using their cannons to try and quickly kill the player.

lines.line: Tips: Entering the base gives four stars; flying over it gives two, which quickly become four if you do not move away; and firing any rocket from an aircraft gives five stars at once.

quoted: Fort Zancudo - Entering the base will give the player a four-star wanted level. Flying over it will give only two stars, although this will quickly escalate to four if the player does not move away quickly. Firing any rocket from an aircraft will instantly result in a five-star wanted level.

lines.line: Summary: A large African American street gang in purple who control almost all of Davis, with the cul-de-sac of Grove Street a hot spot, and a traditional rivalry with the Families.

quoted: The Ballas are a large African American street gang featured in Grand Theft Auto V
with their purple attire matching the teams' colors.
The Ballas control almost the entire community of Davis.
The cul-de-sac of Grove Street is a particular hot spot for activity
They still maintain their traditional rivalry with The Families

lines.line: Weak points: Most of them stand on the sidewalks in groups of 3 to 5 and carry pistols and knives.

quoted: Most Ballas stand on the sidewalks in groups of 3-5. Their weapons include pistols and knives.

lines.line: Tips: They usually leave you alone if you walk through their territory, but they turn hostile if you taunt them enough, fire a gun there or just stand near and stare, and then they shoot, stab or punch you; their dogs sometimes attack too.

quoted: They usually do not attack if the player happens to walk through or pass through their territory.

However, if taunted enough times, or if one fires a gun in their territory, or just because of walking near and staring at the Ballas, they will become hostile and begin to shoot, stab, or punch the player.
Their dogs will also occasionally attack the player

lines.line: Tips: Starting a gunfight with a gang, or killing several of its members in a row, gives you two stars.

quoted: Instigating a gunfight with a gang, such as the Families or Ballas.
Killing several gang members consecutively, whether initially hostile or not.

lines.line: Summary: A motorcycle club whose Los Santos chapter patrols the East Vinewood area in Gang Burritos and runs a clubhouse there, with a hideout in Stab City.

quoted: Another chapter happens to be active in the city of Los Santos as well, mostly seen around the East Vinewood area, where they patrol in their Gang Burritos and operate a clubhouse.
The Lost MC Clubhouse, East Vinewood
They create a new chapter and manage to establish a club hideout in Stab City, known as The Range

lines.line: Weak points: Some ride in small groups of two or three, on Hexer, Daemon and Sovereign bikes.

quoted: Several locations, where groups of 2 to 3 are riding Hexer, Daemon and Sovereign bikes.

lines.line: Tips: After the main story you can still meet them at their East Vinewood clubhouse, Hookies in North Chumash, R L Hunter & Sons in Grapeseed and Stab City.

quoted: After completion of the main storyline, The Lost MC's Los Santos chapter can still be encountered in GTA V at:
Their East Vinewood clubhouse
Hookies in North Chumash
R L Hunter & Sons in Grapeseed
Stab City

lines.line: Tips: If they run into Trevor, they attack him on sight.

quoted: If they run into Trevor, they will attack him on sight.

lines.line: Summary: Sharks in GTA V are fast, dangerous predators that often attack on sight. They spawn more often at night, show on the minimap as a red dot, stalk and circle you for a while before attacking, and sometimes come in pairs.

quoted: are fast and dangerous predators that often attack the player on sight
Spawning more frequently at night, sharks appear on the minimap as a red dot (enemy) and will stalk and circle the player for a while before attacking. Sometimes, they will appear in pairs.

lines.line: Weak points: From a boat one shot kills a shark, so look out for them and kill them from the surface before you dive. You can also run into one with a boat or Submersible, or stab it with a knife over and over, which is extremely difficult.

quoted: Sharks can be killed if the player is on a boat and shoots one, which only takes one shot. It is, therefore, recommended to look out for sharks and kill them from the surface before diving into the water.
They can also be killed in the water by repeatedly attacking with a knife (although this is extremely difficult), or running into them in a boat or Submersible.

lines.line: Tips: A shark kills with its first bite even if you have full health and armor. If you are too deep or too far out to get back to your boat or the shore, swim into sunken plane and ship ruins, which often makes the shark swim away.

quoted: Sharks attack once, killing on the first attack (even if the player has full health and armor)

If the player is in the water and is too deep down/far out to return to their boat or the shore in the event of a shark encounter, swimming into sunken plane and ship ruins will often cause the shark to swim away.

lines.line: Tips: The Hammerhead Sharks added on PC, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One never attack, and if you reach the end of the map a shark is scripted to appear and kill you.

quoted: The PC, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One versions of GTA V have, in addition to the existing Tiger Sharks, Hammerhead Sharks as part of the fauna. However, unlike the Tiger Sharks, they never attack the player.
If the player reaches the end of the map (where vehicles will no longer function), a shark is scripted to appear and kill the player

lines.line: Summary: Large wild cats found in forested and hilly areas from the Vinewood Hills to Mount Chiliad. A cougar growls loudly when it is near, then relentlessly charges, pounces and kills you instantly with a throat bite.

quoted: Cougars are large, wild cats that can be found in forested and hilly areas throughout San Andreas, from the Vinewood Hills to Mount Chiliad
When a cougar is nearby, the first giveaway will often be its loud growl.
When attacking, a cougar will relentlessly charge at its victim, pounce on them, and kill them instantly with a throat bite.

lines.line: Weak points: A cougar runs away if you are driving or firing a weapon and will not attack if you are on top of a vehicle. If you react quickly you can kill or knock out one by kicking it.

quoted: cougars are not tamable and will run away if the player is driving a vehicle or firing a weapon.
Cougars will not attack the player if they are on top of a vehicle.
It is possible, if the player responds quick enough, to kill or knock out a cougar by kicking it.

lines.line: Tips: Trevor's special ability lets him survive a cougar attack with no damage.

quoted: If the player is using Trevor's special ability, he can survive the cougar attack, thus leaving no damage to the player.

lines.line: Tips: In the Hunting side activity cougars spawn often and show as a red circle on the map, like deer, which often tricks you into walking right into an attack.

quoted: In the Hunting minigame, cougars will spawn frequently and they give off a red area circle on the map similar to deer when Trevor uses the diaphragm, often tricking the player into walking right into an attack.

lines.line: Summary: A protective blue vest in five tiers, all bought from Ammu-Nation: Super Light (20%) for $500, Light (40%) for $1,000, Standard (60%) for $1,500, Heavy (80%) for $2,000 and Super Heavy (100%) for $2,500.

quoted: In most cases, body armor in the games is illustrated as a protective blue vest.
These five armor suits can be bought from Ammu-Nation, apart from the weapons area in both games.
Super Light Armor (20% armor)
Light Armor (40% armor)
Standard Armor (60% armor)
Heavy Armor (80% armor)
Super Heavy Armor (100% armor)

lines.line: Uses: Armor pads your health against gunfire, explosions and fire, and in GTA V it also protects you from falls and impacts again. Each tier adds another 20%.

quoted: extending the player's resilience to damage from gunfire, explosions and fire
Body armor once again provides protection from falls and impacts.
Each next level tier provides an added 20% armor

lines.line: Tips: Climbing into a Police Riot gives you armor. It shows as a blue bar next to your health bar below the radar.

quoted: Police Riot (GTA V & GTA Online)
Determines if the gear is awarded to the player by entering a vehicle.
the health bar is now a straight bar located below the radar, occupying the left half of the bottom's width
the right half is reserved for either a full blue bar of body armor

lines.line: Summary: Your health refills by itself only back to the halfway point: when it falls below 50% it recovers up to 50% if you stand still and do not walk or run.

quoted: Whenever the player takes damage and health drops below 50%, then they can automatically replenish lost health up to the halfway point but this can only be done if the player's character stands still on the spot and doesn't walk or run.

lines.line: Uses: Snacks from convenience stores heal you and are eaten as you buy them: P’s & Q’s cost $1, EgoChaser $2 and Meteorite Bar $4, and each heals a different amount. Sprunk or eCola from a vending machine costs $1.

quoted: In Grand Theft Auto V, snacks can be purchased (or shoplifted) from convenience stores around San Andreas. The player automatically consumes the item when purchasing it.
P’s & Q’s || The candy that kids and stoners love. || $1
EgoChaser || The energy bar that's all about YOU. || $2
Meteorite Bar || Dark chocolate with GOOEY core. || $4
Each snack replenishes health in different amounts.
health is provided in the form of drinks (Sprunk or eCola) purchased at vending machines spread throughout Los Santos and Blaine County
Drinks and snacks from a vending machine cost $1 each, similar to a street vendor.

lines.line: Tips: Snacks can also be shoplifted or dropped by dead enemies and pedestrians, and vending machines are not marked on the map.

quoted: snacks (such as P’s & Q’s, Meteorite, Egochaser, and eCola) which can be be purchased at convenience stores, or dropped by dead enemies/pedestrians
Like vendors, vending machines are not marked on the map.

lines.line: Tips: In GTA V you cannot buy food from street vendors or restaurants; the only food you can buy is snacks from convenience stores.

quoted: the player can no longer purchase food at street vendors (all of them are unoccupied) and the once accessible restaurants from GTA IV (Burger Shot, Cluckin' Bell) are no longer able to be accessed.
The player is only able to consume snacks purchased at convenience stores

lines.line: Summary: A $100 parachute from Ammu-Nation, unlocked after the mission Minor Turbulence; getting into any aircraft also gives you one.

quoted: Ammu-Nation (GTA V & GTA Online)
$100 (TBoGT, GTA V & GTA Online)
Minor Turbulence (GTA V)
Any aircraft
Determines if the gear is awarded to the player by entering a vehicle.

lines.line: Uses: After the parachute opens you can fire handguns and single-handed submachine guns. You can open it from a falling bike, but the bike cannot be carried and falls without you.

quoted: The player is now able to shoot single-handed weapons after the parachute has been deployed. The weapons are the same used as the ones used in vehicles, being just handguns and single-handed submachine guns.

The player is also able to deploy the parachute while on a bike that is falling in the air. However, the bike cannot be carried with the parachute, as the player will eject from the bike and let it fall once the parachute is deployed.

lines.line: Tips: Pull back on the movement stick to land safely: pushing forward makes you faceplant, which may injure or kill you.

quoted: it is necessary to pull back the movement stick
Landing while pushing forward on the movement stick will cause the character to faceplant, and this may lead to injury or death

lines.line: Tips: The chute is vulnerable to gunfire and to nearby explosions that set it on fire, and a ripped chute detaches and sends you falling.

quoted: parachutes are rather vulnerable to gunfire
until it gets "ripped apart" and is automatically detached.
Parachutes can also be set on fire by nearby explosions, and will eventually be destroyed as a result, sending the player falling towards the ground.

lines.line: Summary: A 60-ton battle tank with a 120mm cannon. You can buy it for $3,000,000 from Warstock Cache & Carry, and it then spawns in your aircraft hangar, or you can hijack one at Fort Zancudo.

quoted: A heavily-armored battle tank with a 1,500hp turbine engine and a 120mm cannon
The Rhino Tank is stated to weigh 60 tons
Can be purchased for $3,000,000 from Warstock Cache & Carry in single player. The Rhino Tank will spawn in the protagonist's aircraft hangar.
These can be hijacked, but the only garage large enough to store it is an aircraft hangar. And getting one out of the base is relatively hard.

lines.line: Uses: The cannon fires every 1.5 seconds, reaches 190 meters and is very effective against most targets, and the tracks crush small vehicles, which either explode or catch fire. You cannot be busted easily inside it.

quoted: The Rhino Tank is stated to weigh 60 tons, which gives the vehicle the ability to crush various small-sized vehicles.
a fire rate of 1.5 seconds between shots
It fires at a range of 190 meters/623 feet
The cannon is very effective against most targets
Any vehicle struck under the track of the Rhino Tank track are severely deformed and result either in an instant explosion or being set on fire
The hatch location is still an advantage, as the player cannot be busted easily

lines.line: Tips: Keep the cannon off close targets in tight spaces such as alleyways, because the shell can explode right beside the tank and damage it.

quoted: so the player has to avoid using the cannon in smaller areas (i.e. alleyways) for targets that are close to the tank
The cannon of the tank is also dangerous when its shots explode very close to the hull of the tank

lines.line: Tips: The gun is a solid part of the tank, so light poles, traffic lights and walls can block your aim or even get you stuck.

quoted: the main gun is a solid component, meaning that obstacles such as light poles, traffic lights and solid structures can interfere with the aiming of the tank, even having the risk of being stuck.

lines.line: Summary: A handgun by Coil that fires a probe to stun a target and takes about 4 seconds to recharge. You get it in the mission Monkey Business and can buy it afterwards at Ammu-Nation for $100.

quoted: Takes approximately 4 seconds to recharge after firing.
it is manufactured by Coil.
Acquired by Michael in the mission Monkey Business, and can be purchased afterwards from Ammu-Nation for $100.

lines.line: Uses: A stunned person drops and cannot get up, and usually does not survive, although street criminals and animals sometimes get up as if nothing happened. A shot to the head drops them at once, and a person in a vehicle may fall out of it.

quoted: then leave them incapable of getting up, lying on the ground
Usually, Stun Gun victims do not survive; however, in some cases such as street criminals and animals, after being shocked they will get up as if nothing happened.
If one stuns someone in the head instead of the body, they immediately drop to the ground without struggling
If one fires a stun gun at someone who is in a vehicle, there is a high chance that they will fall out.

lines.line: Tips: Its range is only slightly longer than most melee weapons. It counts as a handgun, so it works for drive-bys, but with low damage and a low fire rate; it can also shoot out the tires of vehicles that are not bulletproof, and kill people.

quoted: The Stun Gun has a limited effective range, being slightly longer than most melee weapons.
The Stun Gun can also be used as a Drive-By weapon (since it is classed as a handgun), though the low damage, low fire rate and short range limits its usage
it is capable of being used to shoot out non-bulletproof vehicle tires and to kill people.

lines.line: Summary: A throwable plastic explosive with a remote detonator: you throw it and then detonate it, or attach it to a vehicle and then detonate it. It costs $400 and is unlocked by the mission Friends Reunited.

quoted: A plastic explosive charge fitted with a remote detonator. Can be thrown and then detonated or attached to a vehicle then detonated.
$400 (GTA V)
Friends Reunited (GTA V)

lines.line: Uses: They stick to any vehicle and can be set off at any time, somewhat like landmines, but in story mode they cannot stick to pedestrians. A Rhino in free roam can be destroyed with three of them.

quoted: can stick to any vehicle, and can be detonated at any time (which allows them to be used somewhat like landmines)
Although they cannot stick to pedestrians in Story Mode
The Rhino (in free roam) can be destroyed with three Sticky Bombs

lines.line: Tips: Keep your own car out of the blast radius, because shooting a placed bomb sets it off, and so does ramming one stuck to a vertical surface.

quoted: the player must be careful to ensure that their own car does not get caught in the blast radius
shooting them will cause them to explode. If they are placed onto a vertical surface and rammed by a car, they will detonate.

lines.line: Tips: You can have 20 placed at once, the 21st removes the first, and they never explode on their own.

quoted: The limit for placed bombs has been amplified to 20
first one disappears when the 21st
Unlike in TBOGT, they will not explode over time.
